title: Expand AI testing-plan routing to cover protocol, adapter, release, and security changes
spec: The AI helper CLI's testing-plan command maps a change type to required test evidence, but it only understands a narrow set of change types. Expand the routing so changes touching protocol schemas, adapters, release tooling, and security-sensitive files each map to their own required evidence and commands (for example protocol changes require contract-test evidence; security changes require a security review note), and make the change-type inference recognize those file patterns. Update the CLI self-check to cover the new routes.
